surprises.head: Montréal brought the hits
surprises.body: Montréal’s hit score in the close stretches of the game was 155, against their usual 98 (100 is league average, adjusted for the arena’s scorer). A team strays this far about once every 20 games.

surprises.head: A shutout for Mackenzie Blackwood
surprises.body: Blackwood stopped all 28 shots, worth 2.3 expected goals. Starting goalies have a night this good about once every 20 starts.

story.head: Blackwood shuts out the Canadiens
paras: An ugly night for the Canadiens. Logan O'Connor got the scoring started for the Avalanche midway through the first, and Artturi Lehkonen made it 2-0 just 30 seconds into the second. The Canadiens’ Kaiden Guhle left in the second period and didn’t return. The next day, he was listed as day to day with an upper-body injury. Devon Toews stretched the lead to 3-0 on the power play late in the period, and he scored again with just six seconds left in the period to make it 4-0. Martin Nečas pushed the lead to 5-0 early in the third. Gabriel Landeskog made it 6-0 on the power play with just under two minutes left. Two players had three-point nights: Nečas with a goal and two assists, and Cale Makar with three assists.
The Avalanche carried the play, outshooting the Canadiens 38-28, and got the result to match. Mackenzie Blackwood stopped all 28 shots for the Avs, and Jacob Fowler allowed six goals on 38 shots.

Florian Xhekaj was thrown out with a match penalty in the final minutes. Arber Xhekaj took three penalties on his own. The Avalanche improved to 14-7-3, third in the Central, while the Canadiens fell to 14-8-4, third in the Atlantic.

items.text: The Canadiens are on a three-game losing streak.
Nick Suzuki’s seven-game point streak against Colorado ended.

The Avalanche won without Nathan MacKinnon, Josh Manson and Gavin Brindley. Taking into account how much value each of these missing players usually adds, only the Mammoth were missing more at the time.
Logan O'Connor scored his first goal of the season, his first since Mar 31, 2025 (32 games played since).
